title: Add posture, build, and release-eligibility evidence
expected_outcome: Scheduled posture and build evidence is normalized into OPA decisions that block untrusted builders, digest/provenance mismatches, and stale scans, while retaining only non-sensitive artifacts keyed by commit SHA or digest.
constraints: Do not deploy, publish, merge, alter secrets, access AWS, or access production.
Preserve T-8 thin-workflow and non-sensitive artifact boundaries.
Any optional Grype result must be explicit and fail-closed when policy requires it.

primary_owner.responsibility: security decisions, integration, and final sign-off

delegations.escalation_trigger: artifact inputs or non-sensitive boundary are undefined
raw artifact data cannot be safely summarized
release eligibility cannot be represented fail-closed
